pages.title: About Us — Cornerstone Advisory Group
pages.description: Meet the team behind Cornerstone Advisory Group. 20+ years of financial expertise serving mid-market businesses in the Southeast.

props.heading: About Cornerstone Advisory
props.story:
Cornerstone Advisory Group was founded in 2004 by Catherine Hargrove, CPA, with a simple premise: mid-market businesses deserve the same caliber of financial strategy that Fortune 500 companies take for granted.

Two decades later, our team of 15 CPAs, CFAs, and business advisors has served over 200 businesses across Georgia, Tennessee, and the Carolinas. We specialize in the $5M–$50M revenue range — companies large enough to need sophisticated financial guidance but lean enough that every dollar matters.

Our approach is hands-on and relationship-driven. Every client gets a dedicated advisor who understands their industry, their goals, and their numbers. We don't just file returns — we help you build the financial infrastructure that supports sustainable growth.
props.mission: To give every growing business the financial clarity and strategic confidence to reach their next milestone.

items.question: What size businesses do you typically work with?
items.answer: We specialize in mid-market businesses with annual revenue between $5M and $50M. This includes established companies looking to optimize and growing businesses preparing for their next stage.

items.question: What does a fractional CFO engagement look like?
items.answer: Our fractional CFOs typically work 2–4 days per month with your team. They attend leadership meetings, produce board-ready financials, manage cash flow forecasting, and provide strategic guidance on major decisions.

items.question: Do you handle both business and personal taxes?
items.answer: Yes. For business owners, personal and business tax strategy are deeply intertwined. We handle both to ensure your overall tax position is optimized.

items.question: How is pricing structured?
items.answer: We use fixed monthly fees for ongoing services like accounting, bookkeeping, and fractional CFO. Project-based work like audits and tax planning is quoted upfront with no surprises.

items.question: Can you work with our existing accounting software?
items.answer: Absolutely. We work with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage. If a migration makes sense, we'll handle it — but we never force a switch.
